FlightGridcorrection_3035: TransitionLayer object

Source: R/datasets.R
FlightGridcorrection_3035.Rd

Geo-corrected transition layer for the 1 km EPSG:3035 grid, used by gdistance to calculate distances by sea between grid cells.

Usage

FlightGridcorrection_3035

Format

An object of class TransitionLayer with the following components:

class

The object is of class TransitionLayer from the gdistance package, holding transition values between neighbouring cells.

dimensions

Dimensions of the data grid: 2,200 rows and 1,577 columns, with a total of 3,469,400 cells.

resolution

The resolution of the raster grid: 1,000 metres in both x and y directions.

extent

Spatial extent of the grid defined by the minimum and maximum x and y coordinates. The extent is: xmin = 2661966, xmax = 4238966, ymin = 2685159, ymax = 4885159.

crs

Coordinate Reference System (CRS) used for the grid: +proj=laea +lat_0=52 +lon_0=10 +x_0=4321000 +y_0=3210000 +ellps=GRS80 +units=m +no_defs

values

Geo-corrected conductance values between neighbouring cells.

matrix class

The data is stored in a sparse matrix format (dsTMatrix), which is efficient for handling large datasets with a significant number of zero values.

Source

Generated with gdistance::transition() and gdistance::geoCorrection() on the seabORD sea mask.
